title: Whispering Dunes | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Five Star Properties

description_expanded: Whispering Dunes - Luxury Vacation Rental on 30A with Private Pool and Near the Beach Favorite Features: - Private Pool (Heat Available) - Spacious Deck - Near Beach - 4 Bikes Included - Golf Cart Included (beginning March 2025) More about Whispering Dunes: Whispering Dunes isn’t just a place to stay—it’s a peaceful escape designed to bring people together. This charming home offers 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, comfortably sleeping up to 12 guests. Inside, you’ll find open-concept living spaces with natural light and coastal-inspired décor that instantly puts you at ease. Whether you’re sipping coffee in the loft, cooking meals in the fully equipped kitchen, or gathering for movie nights in the living room, the home is designed for connection and comfort. Each bedroom offers a quiet sanctuary, while the loft adds a flexible space that’s perfect for kids, teens, or extra guests. Step outside and the vacation really begins. The private pool is the centerpiece of the backyard oasis and can be heated for year-round enjoyment—perfect for morning swims, sunny afternoons, or starlit dips. The spacious deck is ideal for everything from morning yoga to family hangouts, with plenty of room to lounge, and soak in the serene surroundings. A grill is available for cookouts, and the home comes with a set of backpack beach chairs for easy beach days. With the Gulf just a few blocks away, you can walk to the beach in minutes or cruise over on the included bikes. A golf cart is also included, making it easy to explore the area—whether you're heading to Gulf Place for dinner or catching a sunset along 30A., whether you're heading to Gulf Place for dinner or catching a sunset along 30A. Whispering Dunes is thoughtfully appointed with everything you need for a stress-free stay—plenty of parking, laundry on site, fast Wi-Fi, and thoughtful extras for a seamless experience. It’s the kind of place where you can settle in, spread out, and make memories that last long after the vacation ends. Whether you’re seeking quiet mornings, beach adventures, or evenings by the pool, this home has the charm, location, and amenities to make your stay unforgettable. Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Bedroom 2: King Bed. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 3: 2 Twin over Full Bunks & Shared Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Balcony & Shared Bathroom with Shower.
